purpose: Give the artist one read-only consumer A/B surface for two exact local Song Versions, with truthful whole-render level-bias evidence when available and no fabricated loudness match or artistic decision.

lineage.outcome: The artist can hear the exact current Song Version beside one exact lineage neighbor and see whether measured whole-render RMS level difference could bias the comparison, without N0TE applying gain or pretending a listening decision occurred.
lineage.capability: Exact local Version A/B audition with bounded level-bias evidence

why_now: Global reselection found REQ-SCOPE-010's Hear-to-Compare experience consumer-incomplete while exact Version lineage, managed local material, safe audition streaming and bounded PCM engineering evidence already existed on main. This bounded integration reused those foundations without depending on or modifying the diagnosis workline.

implementation_contract.pair_binding: Compare the active Song current Version with its exact canonical parent when available. Otherwise use the nearest earlier same-Song Version, or the nearest later same-Song Version when the artist has resumed the earliest Version; never manufacture a placeholder alternate.
implementation_contract.audition_truth: Only verified managed media accepted by the existing audition inspector receives an opaque local media grant; stale or tampered grants fail closed through existing shell checks.
implementation_contract.level_truth: When both sides are supported exact integer PCM WAVs, whole-render RMS difference may be shown only as signal-level bias evidence. RMS is explicitly not LUFS and unavailable evidence stays unavailable.
implementation_contract.mutation: Opening or hearing A/B creates no Song Version, approval, Learning episode, preference, provider call, DAW operation, gain processing or artistic decision.
implementation_contract.artist_authority: KEEP, REVERT, REVISE and INCONCLUSIVE remain separate explicit artist decisions outside this bounded increment.

completion_proof: normal Song consumer path exposes one A/B compare entry point when at least two Versions exist
compare surface names the exact human-readable Version ordinals and labels without leaking private IDs or local paths
comparison remains available after the artist resumes the earliest Version by selecting the nearest later same-Song peer rather than fabricating no-reference state
both verified auditionable sides use existing stale-safe opaque local media grants
supported exact PCM sides surface whole-render RMS/sample-peak evidence with explicit RMS-not-LUFS language
unsupported, unmeasured, silent or corrupted evidence never becomes fabricated loudness matching
rendering and media playback do not mutate current/approved Version, Version lineage, Activity or Learning state
full regression and staged consumer smoke pass at exact head

evidence_snapshot.execution_note: Exact implementation head passed construction governance, context lifecycle governance, supervision, full regression and staged consumer smoke on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS.

non_scope: claiming RMS is LUFS or perceptual loudness
Learning or taste promotion from passive comparison
next_selection_rule: This bounded Hear-to-Compare increment is closed. Keep SONG-01 retained and globally reselect from dependency-valid unfinished product work; do not select an adjacent feature merely because comparison just landed.
